name: Sacrifices And Hardship
overview: Scripture reveals that true sacrifice is not merely external offerings but a heartfelt dedication to God, as seen in Psalms 51:16 where God desires a living sacrifice rather than burnt offerings. Christ calls believers to deny themselves and take up their cross, embracing hardship as part of following Him (Mark 8:34). This sacrificial life involves laboring to support others and finding joy in service, reflecting the blessing of giving over receiving (Acts 20:35; Philippians 2:17). Moreover, enduring tribulations produces patience and spiritual growth, making suffering a purposeful aspect of the believer's walk (Romans 5:3; Romans 12:1).
